_comment: Syracuse — V3 SOURCE-LED COMPLETION BATCH, authored 2026-08-06. This is a SECOND batch for a metro that is already live: batch syracuse-2026-07-31 published 15 rows on 2026-08-06 and they stay exactly as they are. This config imports ONLY the 56 venues the v3 source-led pass added. The two batches share one metro_area ('Syracuse') and therefore one public page — publishing any row here extends /courts/in/syracuse rather than creating a second page.
_why_a_second_batch: The candidates stage aborts when a candidate_key already exists (import-metro-merged.mjs, the collision check: 'candidate_key collisions live (candidates already seeded?)'). All 15 original keys are seeded, so re-importing the combined 71-row artifact under the original batch tag would abort atomically. Splitting is the only non-destructive path; it is not an optimization.
_envelope_comment: Identical to scripts/metros/syracuse.json — derived from the Syracuse, NY MSA COUNTY LIST (Onondaga, Madison, Oswego), not from an observed bounding box. Cross-checked 2026-08-06: all 44 geocoded v3 venues fall inside it, verified by an independent pass over the artifact before any write.
_reconcile_comment: One venue matches a dormant source='osm' status='draft' row and must be an UPDATE keyed on osm_id, never an INSERT — preflight aborts the batch otherwise (slug collision + 0 m proximity). This row is the Stage 2b discovery of the pass: it sat in facility_listings with metro_area = NULL, which is precisely why it was invisible on /courts/in/syracuse and why no earlier pass ever counted it. The reconcile sets metro_area='Syracuse', which is the thing that actually surfaces it. NO COORDINATE TRADE: the research row's own independent Nominatim geocode resolved to this exact OSM node (0 m, identical lat/lng), so the reconcile's coordinate overwrite is a no-op rather than a degradation.

reconciles.note: SAME venue as the dormant OSM row — same name, and the research row's own geocode landed on this exact node (leisure/sports_centre node/8787564129, house number 211) at 0 m. The OSM row already carried the address '211 South Center Street', which independently matches the address read off the venue's own site ('211 South Center Street East Syracuse, NY 13057'); the two agree, so nothing is overwritten with a weaker value. The OSM row is access_type='unknown'; the reconcile patches it to 'public' — Game Point Sports is a walk-in commercial facility (open play $8/person/hour, Mon-Sun 8:00 AM - 10:00 PM), which is the ADR-13 encoding: access is 'who may enter' (public) and the money question belongs to fee_type. court_count is left unset: the venue's own site states no number, and the 6-vs-2 disagreement between third-party listings is not something to resolve by picking one.

_same_site_comment: Carried over from scripts/metros/syracuse.json because BOTH members of this pair are v3 rows and import here. The extract's name-separation pass ran twice and could not separate them — the Village of Manlius outdoor courts were built in 2026 and have no OSM name feature yet — so both rows keep one shared anchor (way/215394545, 0 m). Per the adjudication, syr-manlius-rec HOLDS and syr-manlius-centre publishes.

same_site_pairs.note: Two venues on one site, the same shape as syr-meachem/syr-cecile in the sibling config. The Village of Manlius built SIX outdoor public courts on the old soccer field between Willowbrook Drive and the Manlius Village Centre, ribbon-cut July 2026 at just under $400,000 (Eagle News / CNY Central); the Manlius Recreation Center is the building itself and offers ONE indoor court, members only (cnypickleball.com). Different court sets, settings and access classes. Both carry the address 1 Arkie Albanese Ave and geocode to 0 m; name separation failed twice, so syr-manlius-rec is held rather than published as a second pin on one point. The 6-court public venue is the one a user is looking for.

_expected_publish_history: 2026-08-06 v3 source-led completion batch: first expected_publish block for syracuse-v3-2026-08-06. Authored from --stage=project (43/56 publish, 13 held). Slugs were READ FROM metro-research/syracuse/syracuse-v3-candidates.json, never re-derived — a hand-rolled slugify drops "&" and mangles initials. Hold reasons are the importer's OWN strings ("no coordinate", "research_status=held"), not prose, because the assertion is substring containment against what the importer itself prints.
